newsitem.title: UK: Br Energy volume soars amid placement talk.
newsitem.headline: Br Energy volume soars amid placement talk.

text.p: Shares in British Energy were unchanged on heavy volume on Tuesday amid rumours that HSBC James Capel was placing 81 million shares of the stock on behalf of the UK government, dealers said.
At 1039 GMT, the shares were trading at 147-1/2p, the level Capel was said to have placed the shares.
More than 20.4 million shares changed hands, making it the most actively traded stock in London.
After a lukewarm reception to the flotation, the government was left with about 12 percent of the shares.
